Name: Assir, Son of Jeconiah
Summary: Son of Jeconiah, named in the post-exilic royal line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:17: Son of Jeconiah, named in the post-exilic royal line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Assir stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
